title: The Sky Just Turned Dark Grey

body.en: The sky has turned dark grey and the wind just picked up sharply. Local radio mentions a heavy rainfall warning for your area. What's the smartest move right now?

choices.label: Move valuables and documents off the floor, and check that your drainage is clear
choices.consequence: Smart. A rainfall warning is exactly the moment to act — a few minutes of prep now can be the difference between a wet floor and a ruined house full of damaged belongings.

choices.label: Go outside to watch the storm build
choices.consequence: Not safe. Sudden strong wind ahead of heavy rain can bring down branches or debris — this is the time to prepare indoors, not watch from outside.

choices.label: Ignore it — warnings are usually wrong anyway
choices.consequence: Risky assumption. Even if not every warning turns into a major event, the cost of ignoring the ones that do is much higher than the few minutes it takes to prepare.
